properties.prison.classic.location.list.spawn_descr: The market buzzes, the dorms are cramped, and the mess hall smells of food. Everything's close by, but every step is watched.
properties.prison.classic.location.list.sawmill_des: Ancient trees are being cut down all around. One trunk has already killed a man. Once the timber runs out, the axes will fall silent.
properties.prison.classic.location.list.quarry_desc: The miners' labor is hard and dangerous. A stone from above can end a life, and no one's waiting around to say thanks.
properties.prison.classic.location.list.mountain_fo: The harsh climate wears the workers down, and few last here more than a couple of months.
properties.prison.classic.location.list.pyramid_des: The pharaoh's tomb is grim and abandoned, an ancient curse smoldering within, ready to touch anyone who lingers.
properties.prison.classic.location.list.underworld_: The Underworld drowns you in heat and darkness: every step is a struggle, and working here is nearly impossible.
properties.prison.classic.location.list.castle_desc: The castle's massive walls press down with their severity, corridors full of dark rooms and unfamiliar voices, as if the inmates were caught in a trap.
properties.prison.classic.location.list.royal_garde: The royal cherry orchard is surrounded by blossoming trees, and among them workers labor away, gathering fruit and tending the plants.
properties.prison.classic.location.list.spider_lair: The spider lair is shrouded in darkness, its walls thick with webs, and shadows creeping in the corners send a shiver down your spine.
properties.prison.classic.location.list.sunken_ligh: An old sunken lighthouse rises from the ocean, its walls covered in seaweed, waves crashing all around.
properties.prison.classic.location.list.end_castle_: The Void Fortress is shrouded in darkness, and shulkers in lilac shells lie in wait around every corner, ready to strike.
properties.prison.classic.location.list.farm_descri: The tended part of the farm gleams with neat rows of plots, and the ripe harvest beckons to be picked by hand.
properties.prison.classic.location.list.snowy_hand_: This icy island is harsh and merciless: a cold wind cuts at your face, and blocks of ice make every step dangerous.
properties.prison.classic.location.list.barn_descri: The old part of the farm around the barn has gone to ruin: the overgrowth and debris turn every task into backbreaking work.
properties.prison.classic.location.list.edge_gate_d: The End Gate stands amid chorus plant fields and strange minerals, where every step feels like a trial for the inmates.
properties.prison.classic.location.list.basement_de: A dark, damp place that rats love. Makes you wonder if there are any among the cellmates too.
properties.prison.classic.location.list.warzone_des: The yard is loud and cramped: people from different crews go about their business, but stick together under strict watch.
properties.prison.classic.location.list.ghetto_desc: The gang ghetto — narrow streets, bustle and shouting; each crew guards its own turf and has no patience for outsiders.
properties.prison.classic.location.list.fraction_ba: The faction base is full of different groups: each with its own interests, but all bound by the same rules.
properties.prison.classic.location.list.gang_home_d: The gang base buzzes with life: different crews stick together, but everyone watches their own and is always ready for a scrap.

properties.prison.classic.mine.list.spawn.lore:
§7You're under constant
§7watch, which creates tension,
§7but you have at your fingertips
§7all the comforts of civilization: a market,
§7restrooms, dorms, a mess hall,
§7gym equipment... it's a dream come true!
properties.prison.classic.mine.list.mine_1.lore:
§7Huge, heavy trees have been
§7cut down here for ages. Rumor has it
§7one already fell on someone...
§7But the trees aren't endless, sooner
§7or later the sawmill will be shut down.
properties.prison.classic.mine.list.mine_2.lore:
§7A dense, impassable forest,
§7under the control of
§7bandits. Careful, they carry
§7very sharp daggers that
§7cut through thick branches with ease.
properties.prison.classic.mine.list.mine_3.lore:
§7The miners' hard labor has never
§7been appreciated, it's dangerous and
§7thankless work. Watch out for
§7rocks falling from above, they
§7can kill you easily.
properties.prison.classic.mine.list.mine_4.lore:
§7Unstable climate
§7conditions have a strong effect
§7on the workers' health. Statistically,
§7people work here no more than
§7a couple of months.
properties.prison.classic.mine.list.mine_5.lore:
§7During archaeological
§7excavations, an ancient
§7pharaoh's tomb was accidentally disturbed. Inside it
§7they found a note placing a curse
§7on everyone involved.
§7Three days later almost all
§7the workers died under
§7mysterious circumstances...
properties.prison.classic.mine.list.mine_6.lore:
§7After the terrifying events at
§7the Pyramid, we stumbled upon a passage
§7down to the Underworld. The hellish 
§7living conditions make it impossible to work properly.
properties.prison.classic.mine.list.mine_7.lore:
§7After a failed escape attempt
§7from the Underworld, we ended up
§7in the past. An astonishing castle,
§7ancient objects, people speaking
§7in an incomprehensible language - I think
§7I'm losing my mind. We were made slaves.
properties.prison.classic.mine.list.mine_8.lore:
§7As soon as all the work at the Castle
§7was done, we were sent
§7to work elsewhere on
§7royal territory. 3 unusually
§7small and dangerous mines made
§7us nervous.
properties.prison.classic.mine.list.mine_9.lore:
§7Unexpectedly, we were bought out and
§7sent off somewhere. Sailing across
§7the ocean, we came across
§7an old sunken lighthouse,
§7which we were made to clear out.
properties.prison.classic.mine.list.mine_10.lore:
§7We sailed to a very strangely
§7shaped snowy island.
§7Ice blocks, like fingers of a hand,
§7wrap around it - which is why it
§7got its name.
properties.prison.classic.mine.list.mine_11.lore:
§7We finally arrived at our
§7destination. An old part of the farm,
§7where there's only a barn. We were
§7made to clear out its grounds...
properties.prison.classic.mine.list.mine_12.lore:
§7After we finished with
§7the barn, we were amazed by the new,
§7well-kept part of the farm. We
§7happily started gathering the harvest.
properties.prison.classic.mine.list.mine_13.lore:
§7Footsteps came from behind. A blow. We
§7felt like we were dreaming: unbelievably
§7beautiful floating islands and ships,
§7a huge, mind-blowing temple.
§7How is this even possible?
properties.prison.classic.mine.list.mine_14.lore:
§7We finally managed to reach
§7the temple. We had never seen
§7such beauty before. But the first floor
§7turned out to be filthy - we understood right away
§7what was expected of us.
properties.prison.classic.mine.list.basement.lore:
§7A dark, damp place that
§7rats love so much. Makes you wonder,
§7are there any among
§7the cellmates too?
